components.css: .ds-quick-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 50px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-primary-container, #254777); border: 1px solid rgba(166,200,255,0.3); color: var(--color-on-primary-container, #D4E3FF); font-family: 'Roboto Flex', sans-serif; transition: filter 120ms ease; } .ds-quick-tile:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-quick-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #A6C8FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-qt-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(166,200,255,0.18); color: var(--color-primary, #A6C8FF); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-qt-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-qt-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 17px; } .ds-qt-sub { font-size: 11px; line-height: 14px; opacity: 0.78; } .ds-qt-div { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: rgba(212,227,255,0.22); } .ds-qt-chev { width: 18px; display: flex; justify-content: center; }

components.css: .ds-bar-island { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface-container, #1D2024); border: 1px solid rgba(67,71,78,0.48); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.36); font-family: 'Roboto Flex', sans-serif; } .ds-ws-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #C3C6CF); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-ws-empty { opacity: 0.35; } .ds-ws-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-primary, #A6C8FF); color: var(--color-on-primary, #08305F); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Precision Desktop Slider
components.description: Straight desktop precision track with aligned monospace readout.
components.css: .ds-slider-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface-container-high, #272A2F); } .ds-slider-track { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #32353A); } .ds-slider-fill { width: 68%; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--color-primary, #A6C8FF); } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; top: -4px; left: 64%; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-primary, #A6C8FF); border: 2px solid var(--color-surface-container-high, #272A2F); } .ds-slider-val { width: 34px; text-align: right; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #C3C6CF); }

narrative.overview: z-shell combines Material 3 HCT dynamic color tokens and tonal surface elevation with Linux Wayland desktop ergonomics: zero-scroll popovers, single-owner information architecture, keyboard-first modals, and an independent 820x600 Settings window supporting first-class TSX plugin pages.
keyCharacteristics: Dynamic Color First: 31-role pure-Rust Material 3 HCT palette generated from wallpapers or seed colors with zero hardcoded hex values.
Zero-Scroll Primary Popovers: Every high-frequency bar popover fits cleanly within 1440x900 without vertical scrolling.
Single-Owner Information Architecture: Notifications live in Calendar, quick toggles live in Control Center, and deep/plugin configuration lives in the 820x600 Settings window.
Desktop-Native Ergonomics: Bottom-left anchoring for vertical bars, desktop terminology, and keyboard shortcut hints.

rules.name: The Calm Active Surface Rule
rules.body: Large active desktop controls must use primary-container + on-primary-container rather than solid primary; reserve solid primary to <=10% of any surface for small focal indicators.

rules.name: The Strict Role-Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every foreground token must pair with its corresponding container role to guarantee WCAG 2.2 contrast across arbitrary wallpapers and dark/light modes.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: All live numeric values must use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums inside a fixed-width right-aligned slot.

rules.name: The No-1Hz-Flicker Rule
rules.body: Persistent desktop bars omit ticking seconds by default to prevent peripheral visual distraction.

rules.name: The Zero-Scroll Popover Rule
rules.body: High-frequency transient popovers must fit cleanly within 1440x900 with zero scrolling; rich forms and grids belong in the 820x600 Settings window.

rules.name: The Single-Owner IA Rule
rules.body: Notifications belong to Calendar, quick toggles belong to Control Center, and configuration/plugin pages belong to Settings Window.

rules.name: The Expressive-Budget Rule
rules.body: Wavy progress tracks are reserved exclusively for Media Player and the scalloped silhouette is reserved exclusively for the z-shell brand/Launcher mark.

dos: Do bind all UI colors exclusively to semantic CSS custom properties generated by z-shell-theme.
Do keep every pointer target >= 24x24px and maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast for all body text.
Do use fixed-width slots (flex-shrink: 0) for icons, tabular numeric readouts, and trailing actions across repeated rows.
Do keep all primary popovers zero-scroll at 1440x900, deferring low-frequency telemetry and rich editors to the 820x600 Settings window.
Do bottom-align popovers triggered from the bottom-left Status Island in vertical left-bar mode.
donts: Don't fill large Control Center tiles with solid high-saturation primary, or duplicate Notifications / Do Not Disturb across Control Center and Calendar.
Don't style read-only telemetry (such as AI usage quota) as an active ON/OFF toggle tile.
Don't apply wavy playback tracks to hardware or configuration sliders, or reuse the scalloped silhouette across more than two meanings.
Don't place a destructive Forget trash icon in place of Disconnect on a connected Bluetooth device, or ship mobile Tap copy on desktop.
Don't cram wallpaper browsers, rule editors, or plugin settings pages into a 396px transient popover.
